title: Quantifying black carbon emissions from traffic and construction in central London using eddy covariance
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,785-800
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00039D, Paper
Open Access

Zixuan Cheng, Dawei Hu, Michael Flynn, Eiko Nemitz, Ben Langford, Will Drysdale, Carole Helfter, Samuel Cliff, Dantong Liu, Rutambhara Joshi, James Cash, James Lee, Hugh Coe, James Allan
This study quantified black carbon emissions in central London using eddy covariance and spatial footprint analysis, which highlighted sources co-located with construction sites and traffic.
